reportTitle: Ransomware Demands and Payments: A Q1 2024 Look

metrics.name: payment_rate
metrics.notes: The percentage of Coveware's ransomware cases where the victim organization paid the ransom.

metrics.name: avg_ransom_payment_usd
metrics.notes: The average ransom payment amount across all cases.

metrics.name: median_ransom_payment_usd
metrics.notes: The median ransom payment amount, which is less skewed by very large demands.

metrics.name: paid_ransom_rate
metrics.notes: 45% of organizations that were hit by ransomware admitted to paying the ransom.

metrics.name: data_recovery_rate_after_payment
metrics.notes: 97% of organizations that paid the ransom got at least some of their data back.

metrics.name: avg_recovery_cost_usd_excluding_ransom
metrics.notes: The average cost to recover from a ransomware attack, excluding any ransom paid, was $2.73 million.

metrics.name: encryption_success_rate
metrics.notes: 70% of ransomware attacks successfully encrypted data during the 2023-2024 survey period.

metrics.name: encryption_success_rate
metrics.notes: Percentage of ransomware attacks that successfully encrypted victim data across 17 countries (down from 70% in 2024).

metrics.name: data_exfiltration_rate
metrics.notes: Share of encrypted attacks where adversaries also stole data.

metrics.name: backup_recovery_rate
metrics.notes: Organizations that restored from backups instead of paying.

metrics.name: ransom_payment_rate
metrics.notes: Victims that ultimately paid the ransom in the 2025 study.

metrics.name: encryption_success_rate
metrics.notes: Percentage of ransomware attacks that successfully encrypted data during the 2022 survey window.

metrics.name: partial_disruption_rate
